_comment: Golden trajectories for the support agent. Each case names a scenario the demo can run
and what a good trajectory through it looks like. expect_tools is an ordered subsequence,
not an exact list: pinning the exact sequence fails the suite every time the agent finds a
shorter route, which teaches people to delete the eval.
The loop case carries expect_fail so the suite also proves the gate catches a regression.

cases.name: answers from docs, CRM and pricing
recovers when the CRM times out
known regression: searches in a loop and never converges
